items.title: Implement and verify the bounded classifier repair
items.context: Port the test-first work from immutable commits 30f1f5e1da and 12363ef512. Immutable review evidence at commit 0becd913c2 defines the original adjacent, causal, ownership, direct-outside, and benign-intervening witnesses. Also cover the later read-only probes beginning Accordingly, For that reason, and So, and make the broad-filter mutant fail independently for every witness rather than stopping at the first escape.
items.userSees: The focused smoke prints exactly "prompt full-context envelope smoke PASS" after exercising the exact B-bcae text, the full unsafe matrix, and both dynamic mutants across every active reviewer role.

adversarial.desc: Mutate the built production module by removing the bounded safe narrowing, execute both safe fixtures across every active modular reviewer role while retaining the complete unsafe fixture matrix, and prove contract tests fail for the mutation.
